subject: REVERTED. The byte-identical replicate (v3) shows arm AE is a measured TIE, not a gain. The 2026-09-07 promotion rested on a single run and is withdrawn.

pooled_verdict.reading: DEAD EVEN. Not a regression, and not a gain.

the_mechanism_is_unstable_too: v2 fired 10 stops, v3 fired 3, and the sets of games have ZERO overlap (tn36/lp85/re86 vs ar25/tu93/vc33). The band detector does not find the same bars on the same 25 games across byte-identical runs, so 'the mechanism fires and is correctly targeted' is true per-run but not reproducible per-game.
what_I_got_wrong: I promoted AE into the daily rotation on 2026-09-07 on the strength of v2 alone, one 25-game pass, while the same session's writeup told the owner 'never promote on a single 25-game run'. v2 was the high end of a noisy pair. The four outcome numbers I cited as 'all moving the right way' (levels +4, deaths -26%, strip share -11pp, blind-batch -23pp) do not survive averaging with v3: levels -0.5, deaths/run 0.78 vs 0.806, and the strip share went UP to 87.5%.
action: AE-noimpact REMOVED from the ROTATION in solution/kaggle/daily_submit.sh; rotation returns to D-undo + K-topk100, both of which preflight clean and carry real board draws. The code, tests and candidate stay in the repo; nothing is deleted.
what_survives: The DEFECT is still real and still unfixed: board_changed (solver.py:850) and the no-op guard (noop_guard.py:88-100) hash the whole grid, so a press that only ticks a HUD bar reads as a real change; 84% of control deaths show a consumed edge strip. The port of rank 4's band detector is not a good enough fix, on our stack, to beat the noise. If revisited, the thing to fix first is the detector's stability: a rolling 20-press / 0.9 window finds different bars on the same game run to run.
cost: 3 Kaggle ordinary commits, ~7.2 GPU-h, zero submission slots. The 4th (v3) was the run an adversarial reviewer told me not to buy; it is the run that produced the correction, so the criticism was right about the counter and wrong about the value.
